# MCP Market Russia

> Каталог строительных компаний и недвижимости для AI-агентов. The first business MCP server catalog for the Russian construction and real estate market.

## MCP Server

- Endpoint: https://mcp-market.ru/mcp
- Protocol: MCP (Model Context Protocol) via Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: None (public catalog)

## Tools

### search_companies
Search construction companies by category, region, and budget.
- query: Free text search (e.g., "каркасные дома недорого")
- category: Company category (каркасные_дома, брус, газобетон, кирпич, недвижимость)
- region: Region name (e.g., "Московская область")
- budget_max: Maximum budget in rubles
- limit: Number of results (max 20)

### search_projects
Search house projects across all companies.
- area_min/area_max: Area range in m²
- floors: Number of floors
- material: Building material (каркас, брус, газобетон, кирпич, СИП)
- budget_max: Maximum price in rubles
- region: Company region
- limit: Number of results (max 20)

### get_company
Get full company details including all projects.
- company_id: UUID from search results

### get_project
Get detailed project specifications.
- project_id: UUID from search results

### get_categories
List all company categories with counts.

### get_regions
List all regions with company counts.

### get_stats
Get catalog statistics.

### request_quote
Send a quote request to a construction company.
- company_id: UUID (required)
- project_id: UUID (optional)
- name, phone, email, comment: Contact details
